explanation: Product 1 has three versions, and each one after the first starts the day after the previous one's valid_to. The join pairs each version with the one that starts the next day, so there are two rows: 239.99 to 259.99 on 6 July 2025 and 259.99 to 269.99 on 17 December 2025. The current version has no valid_to, so it is never on the old side.
